scope: The 66 states in interface-assets/comparison.json, not channel application interiors or other comparison collections.
method: Manually inspected all four current captures per state on contact sheets with 50% source and prior overlays. Full-resolution images and a live browser were used to verify suspected defects. Static review is separate from interaction tests.
globalFindings: No screen is certified pixel-identical. Authentic licensed font files do not establish native glyph size, pane metrics or region/firmware matching.
Most sources are low-resolution 4:3 manual illustrations. Centered contain overlays preserve aspect; borders, crops and opposite aspect images are not geometrically registered.
Different content, selection states and dates are identified rather than scored as pixel error.
Missing or related references cannot establish native accuracy.
Phone Quit/OK were checked in the original capture and a live browser and are intact; the initial reduced-overview suspicion was withdrawn.

states.findings: Tile and footer anchors are close to the small 4:3 illustration. Supplied wrench angle, internal gradients, tile label weight and Back skin still differ; widescreen has no independent Options reference.
states.title: Wii Options

states.findings: Save Data reuses the four-icon Options artwork; the manual shows three storage icons. Channels still uses a reconstruction with different corner rounding, stack position and divider. Neither is an exact replacement.
states.title: Data Management

states.findings: The GameCube two-line label sits against the bottom bezel. Platform silhouettes and tile borders remain softer/different from the manual; widescreen is a centered adaptation.
corrections: Raised the GameCube label within the bezel and reduced its two-line text size.
states.title: Save Data platforms

states.findings: The 5×3 structure and tabs are present. Cell bevels, tab edges, spacing and footer text differ slightly from the illustration. The unknown Blocks Open value is intentional browser data.
states.title: Wii Save Data

states.findings: The available source is a Wii save grid, not the Channels grid. Shared tabs and 5×3 structure are inspectable; native channel-cell cropping and item layout cannot be validated from this source.
states.title: Channel Data Management

states.findings: Compared the wide captures against nintendo-menu-3 as well as the 4:3 manual. Wide cells and the footer curve/page-count position still drift. Empty-slot texture, background and return orb also differ; channel inventory is fixture content.
states.title: SD Card Menu

states.findings: The selected-title surface is a dialog over the grid rather than the native full presentation. Native side arrows and the To SD Card Menu label are missing; Copy to Wii Menu is an added browser action.
states.title: SD Channel controls

states.findings: The four rows, page selector and side arrow are present. Label widths/weight and header-tab width differ from the 4:3 reference; the footer Back skin and background scanlines remain approximations. Source is 4.3E and app is 4.3U.
corrections: Reduced shared list label size from 26 to 24 logical pixels.
states.title: Wii System Settings 1

states.findings: Field and two footer actions fit at all four sizes. Header tab and exact field/text metrics drift; saved-status text is added browser feedback and the nickname value differs.
states.title: Console Nickname

states.findings: All digits are visible in the full-size capture. The supplied arrows are smaller/flatter than the manual arrows, and date-column spacing does not exactly overlay. Date values differ; no independent wide source.
states.title: Console Date

states.findings: Complete hour/minute values fit. Arrow size and spacing, numeral metrics and header-tab width still differ; 14:30 versus 10:00 is fixture content, not a layout failure.
states.title: Console Time

states.findings: Both aspect choices and selected brackets are visible. Added screen glyphs and Automatic action are absent from the manual. Choice dimensions and wide placement differ from the 4:3 illustration.
states.title: Widescreen Settings

states.findings: Three choices and both footer actions remain visible. Row spacing, label metrics, gradients and red selection brackets differ. Mono versus Stereo selection is fixture state.
states.title: Sound

states.findings: All four destinations and both arrows fit. Header/label metrics and button surface remain different from the small reference; page 2 selection is consistent at both resolutions.
corrections: Reduced shared list label size from 26 to 24 logical pixels.
states.title: Wii System Settings 2

states.findings: Format Wii System Memory wraps to two lines only in widescreen, while the reference uses one line. The fourth row is crowded. Header/footer proportions and reconstructed surfaces remain separate fidelity work.
corrections: Reduced shared list label size and kept labels on one line in both aspect modes.
states.title: Wii System Settings 3

states.findings: The two-plus-one action layout fits. Native HOME reference has different header, action spacing, footer/battery placement and an opaque dark central treatment; the app retains a translucent channel background and supplied remote illustration.
states.title: HOME Menu

states.findings: Connection text runs under Reconnect in the full-size original. Native volume glyphs, gauge and row-frame proportions differ; charge-unavailable feedback is a browser addition. The manual source is a cropped panel, so whole-frame overlay registration is invalid.
corrections: Reserved 150 logical pixels for row labels so Connection clears Reconnect.
states.title: Wii Remote Settings

states.findings: Card width and its text clamp to fixed pixel minima, so cards shrink relative to the board at 720p. Footer/date and navigation differ from the native reference; the System update card is different content from the two sample letters.
corrections: Replaced fixed pixel minima with frame-scaled card, text, avatar and pin dimensions.
states.title: Message Board

states.findings: Supplied Memo shows a pencil rather than the native small Memo card. Address Book cover lacks the complete native title treatment, and the open envelope/choice spacing differs. All three labels and Back are visible.
states.title: Create Message

states.findings: The title sits high in its grey strip. Mii-frame size, ruled-paper spacing and lower actions differ from the reference. Supplied artwork is preserved; it does not establish native geometry.
corrections: Prevented the heading from shrinking and centered it inside a fixed-height strip.
states.title: Memo composer

states.findings: Full-resolution inspection shows Quit and OK intact. Key labels, language/layout controls, input height and prediction-row treatment differ from the system reference. Shop-derived surfaces and chosen Shop behavior remain deliberate.
states.title: System QWERTY keyboard

states.findings: Accent glyphs and actions fit at both resolutions. The source shows QWERTY, not this accent state, so accent ordering and native state geometry cannot be verified. This is not a symbols match.
states.title: System accent palette

states.findings: Checked the original 640×480 image and live browser after the overview suggested a clipped Quit: Quit/OK are intact. Phone case rail, key grid and backspace fit; native space/language/layout controls and prediction treatment differ.
states.title: System phone keyboard

states.findings: Title is too high in the supplied strip and trash overlaps the paper corner. Native reference is 16:9, while the 4:3 overlays contain that full source; paper width/placement, rules and body text cannot be read as a direct 4:3 pixel match.
corrections: Centered the title lower inside its paper strip.
states.title: Opened Memo

states.findings: Grid and embedded Back fit at both resolutions. Native example is a different month and row count; selected day and message icons differ. Footer type/height and pane shadow remain different. Supplied dated recreations are an additional comparison, not native evidence.
states.title: Message Board Calendar

states.findings: Five empty rows fit. Native page-marker diamond, page-turn arrow art, cover edge and lower button positions are missing/different. The console number is an added line; blank versus populated rows is fixture state.
states.title: Address Book

states.findings: Letter title is visibly cut against the upper paper edge. Stale Friend registered feedback overlaps the baked-in Wii footer, and Save Letter wraps. Source is a Memo composer, so letter-specific geometry remains unverified.
corrections: Matched the heading/body heights to the taller supplied blue strip, cleared stale registration feedback and kept Save Letter on one line.
states.title: Letter composer

states.findings: Sender title is cut at the top; Saved locally overlaps the supplied Wii footer. Trash is positioned on the paper rather than outside it. Sender/recipient wording, paper rules and photo differ from the native letter example.
corrections: Centered title lower inside the taller blue strip and moved local delivery status above the supplied Wii footer.
states.title: Opened letter actions

states.findings: Date/Time submenu, heading and Back fit consistently across four captures. No native reference was collected for this intermediate screen; only internal consistency can be assessed.
corrections: Shared list type uses the same maintained 24-unit token.
states.title: Calendar settings

states.findings: Four destinations fit. Long labels approach the button edges. Native submenu screenshot is missing, so ordering, spacing and title placement are unverified.
corrections: Shared list type reduced to retain edge clearance for long labels.
states.title: Screen settings

states.findings: Offset value and side arrows fit. The adjustment brackets are smaller/inset differently, native arrow art differs, and Reset position is an added action. The browser does not change physical video output.
states.title: Screen Position

states.findings: Two choices and footer actions fit; choice spacing and labels differ slightly from the illustration. The extra display-output note and inability to change a physical TV output are intentional browser behavior.
states.title: TV Resolution

states.findings: Both choices, selection marks and footer fit. The two-row group is vertically offset from the small manual illustration, with different skin/label and bracket metrics.
states.title: Screen Burn-in Reduction

states.findings: Both destinations and Back fit consistently. No native reference for the intermediate Sensor Bar submenu; exact placement and typography remain unverified.
corrections: Shared list type uses the same maintained 24-unit token.
states.title: Sensor Bar settings

states.findings: Two choices fit. Group position, label weight, choice edges and selection-bracket dimensions drift from the 4:3 illustration; wide layout has no independent source.
states.title: Sensor Bar Position

states.findings: Preview is a smaller square rather than the native rectangular IR field. Browser range input and numeric value differ from the diamond slider, and Back/Confirm replace Press A. The two preview dots do not establish physical sensor calibration.
states.title: Sensor sensitivity

states.findings: The PIN/enable/rating form is a browser setup view. Source is the native completed-settings summary; these states cannot be aligned. The inline rounded controls do not reproduce the native summary table.
states.title: Parental Controls setup

states.findings: Three destinations fit, but vertical placement/gaps differ visibly from the illustration. Surfaces and labels have different metrics; native wide placement is unverified.
corrections: Shared list type uses the same maintained 24-unit token; row placement remains unresolved.
states.title: Internet settings

states.findings: On/Off and footer fit; the local-delivery note is extra content. Button spacing/selection state differs. This does not reproduce the retired service.
states.title: WiiConnect24

states.findings: Three destination labels and Back fit in both modes. No native submenu source collected; row placement and the On/Off wording remain unverified.
corrections: Shared list type uses the same maintained 24-unit token.
states.title: WiiConnect24 settings

states.findings: On/Off fit with added browser-delivery note. Source title is Standby Downloads and app uses Standby Connection; region/firmware naming has not been reconciled. Selection and vertical position differ.
states.title: Standby Connection

states.findings: All three choices fit; row positions, labels and bracket/skin dimensions drift from the manual. This stores a preference without operating a physical disc-slot LED.
states.title: Slot Illumination

states.findings: Six text options replace the native one-rating carousel/icon. Instruction placement and footer labels differ. Current source cannot justify claiming the same visual layout.
states.title: Game Rating

states.findings: Question and answer actions fit. No native view source; native question picker, answer entry and state-specific layout remain unverified.
states.title: Secret Question

states.findings: Three saved-profile rows plus two browser controls replace the native three split-column rows. Rounded action skin, row heights, title and selected state differ.
states.title: Connection Settings

states.findings: Wired/wireless choices fit. Native connection-number header and button skin/height are different. This selects a preference and uses the existing browser network.
states.title: Connection Type

states.findings: Grouped Wii Number and online status remain visible at all four sizes. No native Console Information view collected; this browser-local summary is not a measured native replica.
states.title: Console Information

states.findings: Browser storage/network explanation fits. This is custom copy without a native source, not the Nintendo agreement flow.
states.title: User Agreements

states.findings: Three choices fit. Row placement, label metrics, action skin and selection brackets differ slightly from the illustration; full translated interface coverage remains separate.
states.title: Language

states.findings: Visible list is a regional subset near its end, with two rows instead of the reference four-row viewport. Scroll arrows, instruction placement and Confirm versus OK differ.
states.title: Country

states.findings: Warning fills almost all the space between heading and footer, with inadequate breathing room. Browser-specific copy is intentional but oversized; source footer says Cancel rather than Back.
corrections: Reduced warning type/gaps and widened its text column to restore padding.
states.title: Format Wii System Memory

states.findings: Confirmation dialog fits. Available source is the preceding warning, not this modal. Background warning is crowded, and native dialog geometry is unverified.
corrections: Underlying Format warning receives the shared spacing fix.
states.title: Format confirmation

states.findings: Result modal and OK fit. Available source is the update prompt, not the already-current result; exact native modal layout and type remain unverified.
corrections: Underlying Settings list receives the shared label fix.

states.findings: Slot A/B, 5×3 cells and no-card status fit. Source is Wii Save Data rather than a GameCube view. Small GameCube breadcrumb title and physical-card behavior remain adaptations.

states.title: Channel Data item actions

states.findings: Registration fields and footer fit. Source is Address Book cover, not the registration form; detailed native workflow/layout remains unverified.

corrections: Background card uses frame-scaled dimensions.

corrections: Background card uses frame-scaled dimensions.
